The SkipBadTime margin-failure retry mechanism and virtual trailing stop implementation require tick-precision execution unsuitable for bar-based backtesting.

params.reset_logic: If next_martingale_lot > lots_test, reset to initial Lots

position_sizing.conditional_logic: After loss: lots = MathFloor((OrderLots() * Factor) / lotstep) * lotstep; if lots > lots_test then lots = initial Lots. After profit: lots = initial Lots.

custom_logic_notes: Multi-currency martingale reversal EA. Tracks one BUY and one SELL ticket per symbol instance. On loss, reverses direction with multiplied lot (Factor). On profit, reopens same direction with initial lot. Virtual SL/TP monitored every tick (not broker-side). SkipBadTime mechanism: on OrderSend failure, calculates a 'bad day' timestamp and skips all trading until that period elapses - acts as a rate-limit/throttle after order failures. Trailing stop has two modes: BREAKEVEN (moves SL to breakeven after price moves stop_loss distance) and STRAIGHT (trails immediately). The coef variable (currently hardcoded to 1.0) was designed for time-decay adjustment of virtual stops. Settings can be specified per-symbol via a DSL string in _WorkSymbols input with format: name±lots*factor^limit(sl,tp)[start,stop];... Supports duplicate symbol detection. ExpMartinPool manages multiple symbol instances traded simultaneously from a single chart.
python_conversion_notes: Requires tick-level data due to virtual SL/TP monitoring on every tick. MT4Bridge library must be fully reimplemented: MarketInfo (MODE_BID, MODE_ASK, MODE_SPREAD, MODE_POINT, MODE_MINLOT, MODE_MAXLOT, MODE_LOTSTEP), OrderSelect/OrderSend/OrderClose/OrderModify, AccountFreeMarginCheck, Hour(), TimeCurrent(), OrderMagicNumber/OrderSymbol/OrderType/OrderTicket/OrderLots/OrderProfit/OrderOpenPrice/OrderStopLoss/OrderTakeProfit/OrderOpenTime/OrderCloseTime. The martingale lot calculation must respect lot_step rounding (MathFloor pattern). The SkipBadTime state machine (badDay static variable shared across all symbols) must be preserved. Multi-symbol support requires per-symbol position tracking with independent ticket management. Orders sent with SL=0/TP=0 so all exit logic is in code - critical to replicate exactly. The lock detection guard (both buy and sell open simultaneously) must be implemented. Time filter uses broker Hour() not UTC.
